metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Sam's entrance, Richard the Third, and the news at Old Swan.

yesterday: Sam comes on frightened from the door. The tables say from the door.
The afternoon play was Richard the Third. You were out of the gown by four.

Drake and Hawkins sailed from Plymouth on Thursday the twenty-eighth of August. Gannet says six-and-thirty sail and four thousand men, and the merchants' letters say seven-and-twenty ships and some five-and-twenty hundred men.
You said it will be spring before we know.
Tomorrow is a writing day. The street is still to be written, and the talker is still talking.
